comparison.objective: Cut a dough log into four marked portions using bench scrapers.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool alignment, force-controlled chopping, and deformable-material division.
comparison.success_condition: Three valid cuts at the marks, four separated portions in line, no excessive drag or loss, tools down, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable cutting and portion accuracy, unrelated to rigid-body sieve separation.
